method: Same-original readable preview, not equivalent calibration algorithms or seamless stitching. Paired median-ratio bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, seed 12345, percentile 95% interval. Scope is this input, machine and measured peer. Local input HTTP transfer, File creation, JS imports, filens WASM fetch/compilation, intervening Playwright dispatch, renderer construction, native inspection, decode, upload, optional seam completion and two animation frames are included. HTML/CSS shell navigation and browser startup precede timing. Remote NAS/backend/database and cold browser-process costs are not measured.

scope.note: The peer uses a fixed generic dual-fisheye mapping. On this reviewed sample, PSV visibly repeats scene elements across hard seams; filens retains more localized blending/ghosting and better scene continuity at those seams. Both provide readable previews. This qualitative observation does not establish a quantitative or general stitching-quality SOTA, nor a vendor-calibration parser speed ranking.
